differential.name: Medication‑induced hypoglycemia (insulin or sulfonylurea overdose)
differential.rationale: Reduced renal clearance in CKD heightens risk of drug‑related low glucose.

differential.name: Chronic kidney disease‑associated hypoglycemia (impaired renal gluconeogenesis)
differential.rationale: Stage 4 CKD diminishes endogenous glucose production, especially in diabetics.

differential.name: Adrenal insufficiency (secondary to chronic illness)
differential.rationale: Can cause fasting hypoglycemia and is more common in patients with long‑standing metabolic disease.

differential.name: Sepsis or acute infection‑related hypoglycemia
differential.rationale: Systemic infection can increase glucose utilization and suppress hepatic output, leading to low glucose.

differential.name: Malnutrition/poor oral intake secondary to stress and social isolation
differential.rationale: Inadequate caloric intake in a diabetic on glucose‑lowering therapy precipitates hypoglycemia.
